title: Zesty Buttery Ethiopian Teff Dabo
description: A kid-friendly Ethiopian dish featuring teff, with a buttery and bouncy texture, and a bouquet garni for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the teff flour and salt.
Gradually add in the water, stirring with a wooden spoon until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Shape the dough into a round loaf and place it in a baking dish.
Melt the butter and brush it evenly over the loaf.
Add the bouquet garni on top of the loaf and season with black pepper.
Bake the dabo for 35 minutes, or until it is golden brown and has an al-dente finish.
Remove the dabo from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
